deleteAccount.message: {{email}} and everything in it are erased at once: your profile, saved articles, reading, shares and statistics. Backup copies forget it within {{days}}.
deleteAccount.messageHousehold: {{email}} and everything in it are erased at once: your profile, saved articles, reading, shares and statistics. The household {{name}} has no other adult with an account: it goes too. Backup copies forget it within {{days}}.
deleteAccount.messageHouseholdWith: {{email}} and everything in it are erased at once: your profile, saved articles, reading, shares and statistics. The household {{name}} has no other adult with an account: it goes too, with the profiles of {{profiles}}. Backup copies forget it within {{days}}.
deleteAccount.messageChildren: {{email}} and everything in it are erased at once: your profile, saved articles, reading, shares and statistics. You are the only parent of {{children}}: their accounts go too. Backup copies forget it within {{days}}.

signOutDevice.title: Sign out {{device}}?
signOutDevice.message: This device will have to sign in again with your e-mail and password.

removeYoungDevice.title: Remove {{device}}?
removeYoungDevice.message: This device will no longer open {{name}}’s profile. Linking it again will take a new code.

removeMail.title: Stop sending e-mails?
removeMail.message: Hodi forgets the mail server and its password. It sends no e-mail until another one is set.

proof.wrongPassword: That password isn’t the right one.
proof.failed: That didn’t work. Try again in a moment.
proof.wrongCode: That code doesn’t work: use the one your app shows now.

resetPassword.title: New password?
resetPassword.message: The next code lets someone choose a new password for {{name}}’s account, and so get into it. Type your password to make it.

cancelInvitation.title: Cancel the invitation?
cancelInvitation.message: {{name}}’s code will stop working. You can invite them again.

privateOn.title: Make your profile private?
privateOn.message: Your password will be asked to open your profile from Who’s reading?, on every device. On your own ones, tick Don’t ask again on this device.

signOut.title: Sign out of this device?
signOut.message_one: Your profile leaves Who’s in? on this device, but your account and your reading stay intact. {{others}} stays here. To come back later, tap Add and enter your e-mail and password.
signOut.message_other: Your profile leaves Who’s in? on this device, but your account and your reading stay intact. {{others}} stay here. To come back later, tap Add and enter your e-mail and password.
signOut.messageAlone: This device goes back to sign-in. Your account and your reading stay intact.
signOut.messageLast_one: No adult will be signed in on this device any more: {{young}} leaves Who’s in? too, having no account. The device goes back to sign-in, and the reading stays intact. An adult can sign it in again whenever they like.
signOut.messageLast_other: No adult will be signed in on this device any more: {{young}} leave Who’s in? too, having no account. The device goes back to sign-in, and the reading stays intact. An adult can sign it in again whenever they like.

dialogIntro.codeOpen: Type the parental code to open this profile.
dialogIntro.ownOpen: Type your password to open this profile.
dialogIntro.shortcuts: On a computer, without leaving the keyboard. Press ? anywhere to see them again.
dialogIntro.timeZone: It sets when each day starts: new feed, Daily summary, quiet hours and young readers’ screen time.
dialogIntro.country: It places the AI’s web searches: will it rain tomorrow? looks near you.
dialogIntro.share: The original link, to the publisher’s site, to send anywhere.
dialogIntro.addSource: Paste a site’s link, or pick a theme to see suggestions. The source reaches the whole household’s feed.
dialogIntro.replaceSource: Find another source to replace {{name}}. It’s hidden once the new one is added.
dialogIntro.aiTurnOn: Paste an API key from your provider. It’s checked without spending credits, then kept on this server.
dialogIntro.aiReplace: The new key replaces the old one for this account. It’s checked without spending credits.
dialogIntro.sourceTopics: Choose where to file {{name}}. Its articles show up in each theme ticked.
dialogIntro.daily: The reading time allowed each day. Once it’s used up, the app pauses until tomorrow.
dialogIntro.window: The hours when the app opens. Outside them it stays shut and says when it reopens.
dialogIntro.quiet: During these hours no notification reaches their devices. The app stays open.
dialogIntro.explain: Each time {{name}} asks the AI to explain an article or a word. Counted on their account’s credits.
dialogIntro.week: Their screen time and reading over the last 7 days, never the titles.
dialogIntro.topics: Pick the themes shown in their feed. A theme turned off leaves with its sources, nothing is deleted: turn it back on any time.
dialogIntro.sources: The kids’ catalogue, by theme. Base sources start on: keep the ones that suit them. Only sources that are on reach their feed.
dialogIntro.shareTo: Pick one or more people. The article lands in their Shares, with your note if you write one.
dialogIntro.ask: Paste the link of a site or a YouTube channel. Your parents get your request: if they accept, it reaches your feed or Videos.
dialogIntro.request: {{name}} would like this source in their feed. Accepted, it shows up for {{name}} only, filed in the theme below.
dialogIntro.requestChannel: {{name}} would like to follow this channel. Accepted, it shows up for {{name}} only, in their Videos.
dialogIntro.passwordOpen: {{name}} has their own account. Type their password to open their profile on this device.
dialogIntro.shareToHandle: Pick one or more people, or add someone by their @username. The article lands in their Shares, with a word if you write one.

confirmRemoveAll.title: Remove everything?
confirmRemoveAll.message: Hodi restarts to remove {{name}}, with its settings and all its data. This can’t be undone.

add.signedHint: Signed by a key Hodi knows
add.unsignedHint: No one has checked this code: its pages won’t show.
add.signedOnlyHint: It asks for access only verified plugins get: accounts, households, sign-ins, e-mails or notifications.

errors.not_found: The file expired, choose it again.
errors.signed_only: This plugin is not verified and asks for access only verified plugins get.

restart.title: Hodi is restarting
restart.text: It takes a few seconds. The page reloads on its own.
restart.slowText: The restart is taking longer than expected.

plugins.brokenHint: Not loaded: open it to see why
plugins.outdated: It was written for an older version of Hodi. Install its new version to use it.
plugins.outdatedHint: Too old for this version of Hodi
plugins.outdatedToggleHint: Not possible until it is updated
plugins.unsigned: It runs, but its pages do not show in Hodi.
plugins.dev: Installed by npx hodi-plugin dev: its pages show while developer mode is on.

devMode.hint: Run npx hodi-plugin dev to install your plugin each time you save, pages included.
devMode.onHint: Turn it off when you’re done: nobody checks these plugins.

confirm.title: Turn on developer mode?
confirm.message: With its code, anyone can install code no one has checked on this server, and its pages will show in Hodi. Only turn it on on a test server.

devMode.failed: Developer mode could not change. Try again.
devMode.restarting: Hodi restarts without the plugins in development…

plugins.removeAllHint: Nothing stays, neither its settings nor its data.

confirmUnsigned.title: Install this code?
confirmUnsigned.message: Nobody checked the code of {{name}}. It runs apart and only touches its own data and what it declares. Its pages won’t show: only verified plugins add pages to Hodi.

plugins.pageMissingText: This plugin is off or has no page.
plugins.pageFailedText: This plugin could not show its page.

permissions.dataHint: In a database of its own, apart from Hodi’s
permissions.householdsHint: It only deletes households it created
permissions.signInHint: With an account it just created or checked, and refuse a sign-in
permissions.publicRoutesHint: To sign up, join a waiting list or show its own page before sign-in
permissions.mailHint: Through Server › E-mail, 50 an hour at most
permissions.notifyHint: To people across the whole server, on their devices, 10 a day at most for each
permissions.aiHint: A click on its violet button asks the AI one question, paid from the household’s credits. Only if it is Verified.

aiButton.unavailable: AI isn’t turned on for this household.
aiButton.off: The household’s admin turned this plugin’s AI off.
aiButton.limited: Too many requests to the AI for now. Try again later.
aiButton.refused: The AI declined to answer this request.
aiButton.failed: The request didn’t go through. Try again in a moment.

confirmInstall.title: Install {{name}}?
confirmInstall.message: {{name}} is verified. It will read and change what its permissions declare, for every household on the server. Type your password to install it.

catalog.title: Available
catalog.failed: Hodi’s plugin list isn’t answering. Try again later.
catalog.update: You have version {{version}}. The new one installs with the same questions as a file.

errors.signed_only: This plugin isn’t verified and asks for access only verified plugins get.

server.title: Server
server.pluginsIntro: More features, for the whole server, from Hodi’s registry or a file. Each plugin runs apart, with its own data. Only verified plugins add pages to Hodi.

hints.general: Hodi’s address and the home page
hints.notifications: E-mail and push, for each kind

overview.introOne: The server in totals, beside the period before. The server counts, it doesn’t look: never what a person reads.
overview.introSeveral: Every household together, in totals, beside the period before. The server counts, it doesn’t look: never what a person reads.
overview.pluginFailed: This plugin could not be shown.

people.failed: The list could not be loaded.

household.intro: Created on {{date}}. The server sees its accounts and numbers, never what is read there. Only the household’s admin hands over the role, in Settings › Profiles.
household.inviteHint: A code and its QR, valid for 24 h and once
household.fullHint: Full: a profile has to leave before anyone is invited
household.deleteHint: Its profiles, their reading and its sources go with it

confirmDelete.title: Delete this household?
confirmDelete.message: {{name}} is deleted at once with its {{count}} profiles, their saved articles, their reading and its sources. Accounts with no other household go too. Backup copies forget it within {{days}} at most. This can’t be undone.

account.intro: The server sees the account, never what is read with it nor its settings.
account.resetOnRequest: Only once the person asks for one.
account.own: Yours changes in Settings › My account
account.deleteHint: Its profile and all it holds go with it

confirmDelete.title: Delete this account?
confirmDelete.message: {{email}} is deleted at once with its profile, saved articles, reading, shares and statistics. Backup copies forget it within {{days}} at most. This can’t be undone.

account.codeAskedText: {{name}} forgot their password and this server sends no e-mail. Make them a code, then pass it on in person or by message.

people.emptyText: Create your household to read in it, or a household for someone else, who will be its admin.
people.createFailed: Could not create the household. Try again in a moment.
people.otherIntro: For someone else: its profile waits for that person, who becomes its admin with the code. You do not enter this household unless someone invites you.
people.oneText: This server has its own already. To read in it, ask its admin to invite you.

general.intro: Hodi’s address, which the e-mails’ links open, and the public home page. A browser that never opened Hodi lands on that site, for example your presentation page; everyone else lands on Sign in. Then what holds for every account.
general.invalid: Write a full address, with https://.
general.failed: The address could not be saved.
general.loadFailed: These settings could not be loaded.

appUrl.label: Hodi’s address
appUrl.intro: The address Hodi opens at, as people type it in a browser. The e-mails’ links lead there: without it, Forgot password doesn’t show on Sign in.

publicHome.label: Public home page
publicHome.intro: Someone who never opened Hodi in their browser lands on this site, for example your presentation page. Leave it empty to open Sign in.

content.intro: How long the server keeps what it fetches for every household, and how many sources each may follow. Short durations keep the database light; a saved article always keeps its text.
content.failed: The setting could not be saved.
content.loadFailed: The settings could not be loaded.

articleDays.label: Articles
articleDays.title: How long articles stay
articleDays.intro: How many days an article stays in the feed, the search and the topics.

videoDays.label: Videos
videoDays.title: How long videos stay
videoDays.intro: How many days a video or an episode stays in Videos. A video takes almost no room: its title and its picture.

textDays.label: Article text
textDays.title: How long texts stay
textDays.intro: How many days the server keeps the text of an article read in Hodi, and its pictures. A saved article always keeps its own.

maxSources.label: Sources per household
maxSources.title: Sources per household
maxSources.intro: How many sources a household may follow, all its profiles together: the server fetches each one. A household that already has more keeps them, but cannot add any.
maxSources.toggleHint: Otherwise each household adds as many as it likes.

validation.label: Review sources
validation.hint: A source added waits in To do before it enters the catalogue
validation.failed: The setting couldn’t be saved. Try again in a moment.

backups.intro: Every night, a copy of the whole database and of the plugins’ data. It holds everyone’s data: your password protects it, and keeping one off the server is wise. A single account’s copy is in Settings › My account.
backups.keptIntro: How many copies the server keeps: the oldest goes when a new one comes. Deleted data stays at most this many days in the copies.
backups.failed: The copy could not be made.
backups.saveFailed: The setting could not be saved.
backups.loadFailed: The copies could not be loaded.
backups.downloadIntro: The copy of {{date}} at {{time}} holds everyone’s data. The account’s password protects it.
backups.downloadFailed: The copy could not be downloaded.
backups.restoreIntro: The whole server goes back to {{date}} at {{time}}: accounts, households, reading, the plugins’ data. What changed since is lost, but Hodi first keeps a copy of how things are now. What was deleted since stays deleted: an account, a profile, a household. A plugin removed since does not come back: its data stays 30 days, time to install it again. Then Hodi restarts, and people sign in again if needed.
backups.restoreFailed: The copy could not be restored.

mail.intro: The server Hodi sends its e-mails through: Forgot password and the plugins’ ones. Until it is set, Hodi sends none and that link doesn’t show on Sign in.
mail.userPlaceholder: Empty if the server asks for none
mail.dialogIntro: These settings come from your e-mail provider (Gmail, OVH, Infomaniak…). STARTTLS goes with port 587, TLS with 465.
mail.invalid: A field isn’t valid: check the server, the port and the sender’s address.
mail.testHint: An e-mail to this account’s address
mail.failedUnreachable: The server doesn’t answer: check the server, the port and the security.
mail.failedAuth: The server refuses the user name or the password.
mail.failedRefused: The server refuses the e-mail: check the sender’s address.
mail.serverIntro: The mail server’s address and its security, given by your e-mail provider (Gmail, OVH, Infomaniak…). STARTTLS goes with port 587, TLS with 465.
mail.loginIntro: The mail server’s user name and password, often your e-mail address and its password. Leave it empty if the server asks for none. Once saved, the password is never shown again.
mail.senderIntro: The address Hodi’s e-mails come from, for example no-reply@example.com. The mail server must accept it.

notifications.title: Alerts
notifications.intro: How the server lets you know of each thing: by e-mail to your address, in push on your devices, or both. Everything also stays in Notifications.
notifications.noMailTitle: The server’s e-mail isn’t set up
notifications.noMailText: E-mail notifications stay off until then.
notifications.emptyText: Installed plugins add here what they can tell you.
notifications.denied: Notifications are blocked for Hodi in this browser.
notifications.unsupported: This browser can’t receive notifications. On an iPhone, add Hodi to the home screen.
notifications.failed: Couldn’t turn push on for this device.

weeklyReport.label: Weekly report
weeklyReport.hint: On Monday at 08:00, the week’s numbers

sourceReview.label: Sources to review
sourceReview.hint: When a source added waits for a decision

inbox.intro: What the server asks you to do. A request dealt with moves to Handled, where it stays 7 days.
inbox.emptyHint: What the server asks you to do lands here.
inbox.handledEmptyHint: A request dealt with stays here 7 days.
inbox.noneHint: Pick a request in the list.

source.teenHint: Parents may give it to a teen
source.childHint: Parents may give it to a child

test.subject: Hodi: test e-mail
test.title: It works
test.text: This e-mail comes from Hodi. The mail server is set up right: Hodi can send its e-mails.

reset.subject: Hodi: choose a new password
reset.title: New password
reset.text: A new password was asked for the Hodi account {{email}}. Enter this code on the Forgot password page, or open the button: it works for an hour, once.
reset.note: If you didn’t ask, ignore this e-mail: the password stays the same.

serverNotice.note: You get this e-mail because you run this server. Choose what it tells you in Server › Alerts.

weekly.title: {{from}} to {{to}}
weekly.text: The week’s numbers across the server, compared with the week before.

codeRequest.title: {{name}} asks for a code
codeRequest.text: {{name}} ({{email}}) forgot their password. Make them a code in Server › Accounts, then pass it on.

invite.subject: {{name}} invites you to Hodi
invite.title: Your invitation to Hodi
invite.text: {{name}} invites you to Hodi. With this code you make your own account. It works for 24 hours, once.
invite.note: If you don’t know this person, ignore this e-mail: without the code, nothing happens.

sourceReview.title: Source to review: {{name}}
sourceReview.text: {{name}} was just added. It stays out of the catalogue until it is accepted in To do.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter your account’s e-mail. You get an 8-character code there, then you choose a new password.
forgot.codeIntro: If an account has the address {{email}}, a code is on its way. It works for an hour. Not there? Look in the spam folder, or send it again.
forgot.codeIntroTyped: The 8 characters you got by e-mail. The code works for an hour, and once.
forgot.wrongCode: This code doesn’t work: it may have been used already, or its hour is over. Ask for another one.
forgot.failed: The code could not be sent. Try again in a moment.
forgot.newIntro: For {{email}}. Once saved, your other devices sign out and this one signs in with the new one.
forgot.doneIntro: Your new password is saved. It now works on each of your devices: keep it in a password manager so you never have to look for it again.
forgot.doneText: Your other devices are signed out, this one is already signed in.
forgot.askIntro: This server sends no e-mail: its admin makes you an 8-character code. Enter your account’s e-mail and ask for it: the admin is told and passes the code on to you.
forgot.askedIntro: The server’s admin got your request. Once they pass you the code, enter it here. It works for 24 hours, and once.
forgot.askedIntroTyped: The 8 characters the server’s admin passed you. The code works for 24 hours, and once.

scan.app: Install an authenticator app on your phone: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, Aegis…
scan.qr: In the app, add an account and scan this QR. Without a camera, type the key beside it.
scan.type: Type the 6-digit code the app shows for Hodi.
scan.wrong: That code doesn’t work: use the one the app shows now. If it still fails, check your phone’s clock.
scan.link: Tap the button: the app opens and adds Hodi. If nothing opens, add an account in the app and type the key.

codes.title: Keep your recovery codes
codes.intro: Without your phone, each of these codes replaces the app’s once. Keep them in your password manager or on paper: Hodi won’t show them again.
codes.label: Recovery codes

setup.title: Protect your account
setup.intro: This account runs the whole server. On top of the password, it will ask for a code from your phone each time you sign in on a new device.
setup.help: The server’s account can create and delete accounts, install plugins and restore backups. A stolen password isn’t enough to take it: your phone is needed too.

account.dialogIntro: On top of the password, Hodi will ask for a code from your phone each time you sign in on a new device.
account.done: On: your next sign-in on a new device will ask for the code.

confirmOff.title: Turn off verification?
confirmOff.message: Your password alone will open your account from a new device again, and your recovery codes will stop working. Type your password and your app’s code to confirm.

confirmCodes.title: New recovery codes?
confirmCodes.message: The old codes will stop working. Type your password and your app’s code to get 10 new ones.

confirmOn.title: Turn on verification?
confirmOn.message: Type your password: Hodi then shows the QR to scan with your authenticator app.

login.title: Your app’s code
login.intro: Open your authenticator app and type Hodi’s 6-digit code.
login.recoveryIntro: One of the 10 codes you kept when turning on two-step verification. Each works once.
login.wrong: That code doesn’t work. Use the one the app shows now.
login.signInNow: Done: sign in with your e-mail, your password, then your app’s code.

server.intro: This account runs the whole server: before the Server space opens, add a code from your phone to your password. Type your password to begin.

pluginSignIn.title: Two-step verification
pluginSignIn.message: This account is protected by two-step verification. Type the 6-digit code the app shows for Hodi.

seo.title: Hodi - News for the whole family, free and everywhere
seo.description: Your favourite news sites, sorted by topic, all in one place. An account for everyone, sharing what’s worth reading.

noHousehold.title: You no longer have a household
noHousehold.text: Your account {{email}} is in no household any more, but it still exists: you find it in My account. To join a household, sign out, then type in I have a code the one an adult of it gives you.
noHousehold.deleteMessage: {{email}} is erased right away. Backup copies forget it within {{days}} at most.

intros.profile: The name, photo and colour others see, and Hodi's language.
intros.sign-in: How you sign in, and the devices where the account is open.
intros.region: The time zone says when a day starts: the statistics', the Daily summary's and the badges'.
intros.data: A copy of everything Hodi keeps about the account, or deleting it.
intros.ai: Each purple button is a call to the AI, paid with this account's API key: nothing goes without a click. Calls count over a rolling 24 hours, with no cap: the key is yours.
intros.children: The teens’ and children’s accounts you run: each signs in with their username and the password you choose.

parents.already: This account is a parent already.

sourceCard.askText: The parents approve it before it arrives.
